text_block_list.text: The summer training camp season has arrived once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "What should we start with, desu ka? Watermelon splitting? Fireworks? Barbecue?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course that's not all!
The most important thing is training!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Bring on the hard training
for the Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san!
Let's train hard toward victory!
And so, the training camp got underway.
